action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    if not (isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) and isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) and isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray)):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must be numpy arrays")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must be 2D")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    if logp_with_result.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must be non-empty")
    if not (np.isfinite(logp_with_result).all() and np.isfinite(logp_call_only).all() and np.isfinite(logp_no_call).all()):
        raise ValueError("All input values must be finite")
    if not ((logp_with_result <= 0).all() and (logp_call_only <= 0).all() and (logp_no_call <= 0).all()):
        raise ValueError("All input values must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, (bool, np.bool_)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a Boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")

    # Sum log probabilities along the future horizon
    sum_with = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    sum_call = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    sum_no = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Margin = min( improvement over call-only, improvement over no-call )
    margin = np.minimum(sum_with - sum_call, sum_with - sum_no)

    # Keep if margin exceeds threshold
    keep = margin > tau_filter

    return keep, margin
